matched: KNN is an unsupervised ML model measuring distance between feature values for classification or regression
KNN addresses classification and finds k-nearest neighbors of sample to be predicted for regression
KNN advantages: high precision, insensitivity to outliers, no input assumption for sample labels
KNN drawbacks: high computational and space complexity, primarily applicable for numerical and nominal data
KNN application range circumscribed compared to SVM, ANN, and tree models
Environmental applications: water quality monitoring, wastewater treatment control, adsorption evaluation, air quality prediction
